text:
devon: Heads-up — prepping a quant bakeoff next week for FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ. Need a calibration dataset and a curated prompt mix that reflects deployment profiles. Who can take point on the cal-set?
maya: I can lead cal-set assembly. Quick q: target size? we should balance speed of runs vs statistical power.
liam: Agree. Proposal: ~12k total prompts, stratified by domain (conv, code, math, knowledge, edge). keep a separate 10% holdout for final checks.
anya: Also add a set of negative controls (nonsensical inputs, prompt inj attempts, red-team examples) — helps catch regression modes post-quant.
sam: Suggest a quota approach: 40% conversational/instruction, 20% code, 15% math/structured, 15% knowledge/fact, 10% adversarial/edge. keep seeds deterministic for replay.
devon: Nice. We also need per-prompt metadata for slicing: domain, difficulty, length, expected behavior. Can we agree on a compact CSV schema?
maya: Draft schema: `id,domain,length_tokens,difficulty,seed_source,expected_flag` — will generate manifest with those columns.
liam: For sampling, use stratified random within buckets + 2x oversample for rare edge-case types so we can stress-test quant variants. Also mark "latency-sensitive" examples for tail latency checks.
anya: Metrics we care about: exact match / EM for math, F1 for extractive, embedding-sim sim for open instructions, and a human-ish quality flag for instruction adherence. Put threshold gates in CI.
sam: Gate suggestions: EM drop >5% on math bucket => fail; average embedding cosine drop >0.03 on instruction set => warn; hallucination rate increase >8% => fail. open to tweaks.
devon: Sounds actionable. maya: assemble cal-set (12k + 10% holdout) and upload to S3 under `s3://redwood-evals/quant/bakeoff/1748004321/`. liam: define slicing and failure thresholds in eval config. sam: write prompt-mix YAML for runner. deadline: EOD Friday?
maya: On it. I'll source 12k prompts, keep provenance (public datasets + internal support logs + synthetic edges). will tag each item with `provenance` in manifest.
bench-bot: Scheduled bakeoff job queued: `run/1748004321/1` — config pending upload. :gear:
liam: one more ask — include a tiny reproducible sample (100 prompts) we can run locally to sanity-check runner changes before the full run.
devon: Great call. let's aim for a dry-run w/ 100 sample prompts tomorrow. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
